mission.label: About us
mission.title: Total Charm Dent
mission.missionText: Our mission is to offer patients modern, painless and high-quality dental care. We believe a healthy smile matters for both physical and psycho-emotional wellbeing, and we do everything so that every one of our patients feels it.
mission.visionText: To become one of the most trusted and advanced dental clinics in the Caucasus region, where the patient receives not only quality treatment, but also care, attention and an individual approach.

team.label: Our specialists
team.title: Professionals in their field
team.lead: At Total Charm Dental we have gathered the best doctors. Every specialist has completed an internship in European clinics, mastered modern techniques and works to international protocols. Regular training and participation in dental congresses allow them to continuously raise their level of qualification. Paediatric dentistry is handled only by doctors with the relevant specialisation and many years of experience working with children.

technology.label: Technology
technology.title: Premium digital equipment
technology.lead: We have done everything to make modern dental technology accessible to you. Premium digital equipment from European and American manufacturers allows us to:

items.title: Microscopic precision in prosthetics
items.text: During the very first visit, temporary orthopaedic constructions are created using 3D models of implants and crowns, and fixed immediately. While waiting for permanent veneers or crowns, the patient never has to experience the discomfort of missing teeth.

items.title: Innovation in aesthetic dentistry
items.text: Digital planning and predictable treatment outcomes. The patient always knows what to expect from any given treatment method.

items.title: Safe instrumental research
items.text: Instrumental examinations are carried out with maximum efficiency and safety — computed tomography is available with the lowest radiation dose.

items.title: The full spectrum of orthodontics
items.text: Selection and placement of the optimal orthodontic treatment — all types of appliances, bracket systems and aligners to create a correct bite.

items.title: Three-stage sterilisation
items.text: The safety of patients and doctors is ensured through three-stage sterilisation and control, made possible by our own top-class sterilisation department. This is an unprecedented level of processing for reusable instruments and handpieces, combined with the availability of single-use consumables in any quantity required.

technology.note: Every procedure is performed under anaesthesia. Adults and children who come to us are no longer afraid of the dentist.

faq.label: Questions
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Can't find your answer? Call us or message us on WhatsApp — every day, 9:00 to 21:00.

items.a: Every procedure is performed under anaesthesia. Your dentist explains each stage in advance and works at your pace — which is why the adults and children who come to us are no longer afraid of the dentist.

items.q: How do I book a visit?
items.a: Three ways: fill in the form on this page, call us, or message us on WhatsApp. We are open every day from 9:00 to 21:00, with no closing days.

items.q: What does the first consultation cost?
items.a: A first consultation is 50 GEL; a follow-up consultation is 25 GEL. That covers the oral examination and a written treatment plan with the costs set out. You only pay for the treatment itself once you have approved the plan.
Yes. Paediatric dentistry is handled only by doctors with the relevant specialisation and many years of experience with children — from milk teeth through to teaching good hygiene habits.

The clinic has its own top-class sterilisation department and a three-stage sterilisation and control process. Reusable instruments and handpieces go through a full cycle after every patient, and single-use consumables are always stocked in the quantities required.

items.q: How many visits will my case take?
items.a: That depends on the diagnosis, which is why we start with imaging — computed tomography and digital planning. You receive the plan after your first visit, with the stages and timeline set out, so there are no surprises later.
